llmResponse.agenda_changes: At the beginning of the meeting, the President asked 'Are there any changes to the agenda this evening?' A trustee proposed moving items 10.5, 10.6, 10.7 to consent, and also moving items 10.3 and 10.4 to consent. This motion was seconded and approved. Later, a motion was made to move consent items including 10.3, 10.4, and items 5, 6, 7, with confirmation that 10.2 was not included.
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: Do I have a motion to approve all those three? Cecilia and second. Mike, all those in favor?
